intro.title: Secure Token Rotation
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a secure React application that automatically refreshes an authentication token when it expires, preventing users from being logged out unexpectedly. You will learn the core concept of token rotation by implementing a custom React hook that manages the token's lifecycle, including fetching a new one before it expires. The main technologies involved are React with TypeScript for type-safe state management, and the browser's Fetch API for making HTTP requests. This beginner-friendly project will help you understand how to keep user sessions secure and seamless in modern web applications.
intro.usecase: Secure token rotation is essential in any application that maintains user sessions, such as banking dashboards, e-commerce platforms, and productivity tools like Notion or Slack. When you stay logged into your email or social media account for hours, the system silently refreshes authentication tokens in the background to prevent session expiration without interrupting your workflow. This pattern ensures continuous access in admin panels, data visualization tools, and collaborative editors while maintaining security against token theft or replay attacks. Developers implement this to balance user convenience with robust security in long-running single-page applications.
